subject: Recap: Discovery + Next Steps — Stakeholders & Procurement Roadmap

To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@greennet.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap

Thanks for the walkthrough today, Sergio — really helpful. A couple of quick clarifications and asks from my side so I can keep momentum internally: 

- Can you send a one-page ROI that I can share with Priya (CFO)? High-level ops savings + example TCO math would be ideal.
- Procurement will want a checklist: SOC 2 evidence, SSO/SAML support, data residency options, and a sample contract with standard terms.
- Who do I loop for a technical security call next week?

We have a weekly vendor sync on Thursday afternoon; I'd love to have a short mutual action plan (MAP) before then so I can show a clear timeline.

Thanks,

Director of AI Programs | GreenNet

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greennet.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Berger <tberger@greennet.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap

Elena — great to meet you earlier. Attaching the one-pager and a draft MAP for GreenNet (see attachments). Quick answers inline: 

- ROI one-pager: attached (Redwood-ROI-OnePager.pdf). It includes a simple TCO model for a 3x month-to-month vs reserved capacity scenario and conservative savings from batching/kv-cache.
- Security checklist: we support SSO/SAML, 12/24/36 month retention choices, and can provide SOC 2 Type II report and penetration test summaries under NDA. Neha is on copy to coordinate the security packet.
- Contract/terms: Ben will share a starter SOW and commercial ranges.

Proposed next steps (suggested MAP):
1) Security deep-dive (Neha) — Wed 08/26 11:00am PT — 60min
2) Commercial range + PO cadence (Ben) — Thu 08/27 10:00am PT — 30min
3) Exec sync with Priya (CFO) — week of 09/07 — 30min

Can you confirm if those time windows work for your team? If Thursday vendor sync is firm, we can pull the MAP into that meeting.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-ROI-OnePager.pdf, GreenNet-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greennet.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap

Thanks for looping me in, Elena. Quick security checklist and what I can bring to the call: 

- Deliverables I will provide on the call or directly after: SOC 2 Type II summary, penetration test executive summary, data flow diagram for our hosted offering, and our standard encryption-at-rest/in-transit docs.
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC; we can demo an IdP integration on the call.
- Data residency: We can pin model serving to us-west regions; we also offer Private deployment for stricter residency (we can discuss DPA language with Legal).
- Typical procurement asks: SLAs (uptime/latency), breach notification timeline, subcontractor list, and export controls.

I can take the 11:00am PT slot tomorrow (Thu 08/26) for a 60-minute security deep-dive and will bring our security checklist. Please share any specific compliance templates you need us to fill out prior to the call.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greennet.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap

Elena — following up with commercial context as discussed. High-level pricing ranges and a starter MAP are attached (GreenNet-MAP-draft.xlsx). Notes: 

- Two commercial paths: Hosted (consumption + per-token) for fast onboarding vs Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) for predictable throughput and lower marginal cost at scale. I included a sensitivity table for 3 usage profiles.
- Proposed initial commitment to get to a pilot (4–6 weeks): $Xk reserved credit to cover baseline throughput + standard onboarding services.
- Typical procurement milestones: security package receipt, PO issuance, legal redlines acceptance (we route through our enterprise legal team), and pilot kickoff.

Next step: If procurement wants standard terms, we can prepare a draft order form and DocuSign route once scope is agreed — I can draft the PO template after the security call.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: GreenNet-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greennet.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@greennet.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@greennet.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — quick recap

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the materials — this is super helpful. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync overnight: 

- Procurement (Tom) wants the security packet and a draft order form before their Monday vendor shortlist meeting. Tom, can you confirm the specific template you want (our standard PO vs SOW)?
- Priya is open to a short CFO-level overview — Sergio, can you prepare a 20-minute ROI + risk slide for 09/08?
- I will host a combined vendor Q&A on Monday 08/31 at 2:00pm PT. Can Redwood come with a short 10–12 minute talk track for the champion slot and be prepared for procurement questions?

If we can get the security packet and a draft order form into Tom by EOD Friday, I think we can keep GreenNet in the shortlist.

Thanks — looping Priya for visibility.

Best,
Elena
Director of AI Programs | GreenNet
